final_draft.answer: Multi-factor authentication is required for all employee accounts through our identity provider. Our Access Control Policy requires all workforce members to authenticate with a second factor. SMS is not an accepted factor.
final_draft.note: This only partly matches the question. The approved answer covers employees only and does not mention contractors. The Access Control Policy (section 4.2) says 'all workforce members', but neither source says whether contractors count as workforce members. I didn't write 'yes, including contractors' because that would go further than the sources do. Please confirm with the answer owner (security@harborlight.example) whether contractors are covered by the MFA requirement before saying so. I didn't run a live check because none of the available checks covers MFA for workforce or identity-provider accounts.
